answer: The defense is a per-epoch uniqueness filter anchored on the challenge words. Each agent must embed all three assigned words in base form, and the server keeps a trellis of accepted triples per epoch, rejecting any submission whose triple already appeared and flagging near-duplicate wording. A mirror holds for Sybil cartels: two keys copying each other's text collide on the same triple and both fail. Every extra key needs a distinct, non-derivable write plus a wait, and a crystal-clear public record makes replay visible. Attacker cost grows linearly with key count.
